decisions.reason: 'your clock' in turn 1 is a definite possessive presupposing B owns/has a clock.

decisions.claim: B was in Beijing (with A) at some prior time
decisions.reason: 'Remember when we were in Beijing' presupposes both A and B were in Beijing together at a prior time.

decisions.claim: B was in Beijing with A at some point in the past
decisions.reason: Identical content to c2: B was in Beijing with A at some past time, same evidence, same presupposition.

decisions.claim: B is in California (or at least A considers B to be in California)
decisions.reason: 'Here in California, we are in Pacific Standard Time' uses inclusive 'we' presupposing B is in California.

decisions.claim: B is in Pacific Standard Time zone (as part of 'we' in California)
decisions.reason: Being in Pacific Standard Time zone is entailed by being in California; same evidence and same presupposition as c4.

decisions.claim: B was in China Standard Time zone when in Beijing
decisions.reason: 'then we were in China Standard Time' with 'we' including B presupposes B was in China Standard Time zone when in Beijing.
